posts.title: Ban AI Slop, Not AI Help With English
posts.description: English is my third language. AI helps me phrase my posts, and community rules that ban AI-written text ban exactly that. A rule should judge whose knowledge stands behind a post, not which tool shaped its sentences.

posts.title: A Startup Stack With No Credits to Expire
posts.description: Startup credits last up to 12 months. After that, the usual SaaS stack costs a solo founder about 260 to 380 USD a month at list price. My startup stack needs no credits and runs for about 20 to 40 EUR, with the AI subscriptions I build with on top.

posts.title: Plan With the Frontier Model, Build With the Cheap One
posts.description: Claude Fable 5 ran a nonprofit's club-management system through Spec Kit's full round trip, twice, unattended, inside a free access window that would otherwise cost about $85. A cheaper model, picked for being the best fit for the language, builds it this weekend.
